musical_instruments_brand_count: SELECT a.attr_val, COUNT(DISTINCT a.ref_id) AS product_count FROM attributes a WHERE a.category = 'musical instruments' AND a.attr_key = 'Brand' GROUP BY a.attr_val HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.ref_id) >= 50 ORDER BY product_count DESC, a.attr_val ASC
musical_instruments_avg_price: SELECT b.attr_val, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM attributes b JOIN products p ON b.ref_id = p.ref_id WHERE b.category = 'musical instruments' AND b.attr_key = 'Brand' GROUP BY b.attr_val HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.ref_id) >= 50 ORDER BY avg_price DESC, attr_val ASC
